_comment: Kavach native hooks for Google Antigravity (agy) CLI — successor to the retired Gemini CLI. Install to ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json (the shared agy hooks path per antigravity-cli CHANGELOG v1.0.8). Every command is the SAME kavach binary with --vendor antigravity; kavach lowers agy's PascalCase payload into its canonical pivot, runs the gate, and renders agy's native {"decision":"allow"|"deny","reason":...} output. agy blocks via the decision body, not an exit code. SOURCES: https://antigravity.google/docs/hooks · github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli
